text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~. Please be sure to 
visit again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ryan the coffee shop owner. Occasionally, 
Mejiro Ryan is entrusted by an 
acquaintance to run their cafe, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is coming up, huh. In that 
case, our shop ought to do something 
special too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, completely handmade chocolate~ !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I don't just want to melt and shape 
chocolate, I want to make it from the raw 
ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to give a spoonful of courage to 
someone"— that's why I want to hand out 
chocolates to the girls confessing their 
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono! Alright, I'll whip up the recipe, 
so let's all do our best~☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"First we crush the cacao, huh? Alright, 
into the food processor it goes..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, hold on, Biko-chan. I'll do the rest 
by hand properly.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, but wouldn't that take an 
incredible amount of strength... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It might be tough, sure. It might not even 
be worth the effort. But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like doing it by hand gives it 
slight imperfections that create a truly 
special flavor. Rather than tasting all 
mechanical and processed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought... maybe that's what love is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Love...♪ You're right, Ryan! That way of 
thinking might just be buono! Alright 
then, let's give it our best shot☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... It's so hard... Way 
tougher than I imagined... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
More finely... even more! Even if my arms 
burst apart... Oooohhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haa! Haa! Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ryan-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! Lend me that pestle, Ryan-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero is always on the side of those who 
try their best! I'll never let you do it 
alone!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, let's take turns☆ And then at the 
very end--!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A dash of the ultimate Marvelous~☆ Now 
this is super Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: It's doooone!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, give it a taste, Ryan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, here I go...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... This is amazing... It's on a 
completely different level from regular 
homemade chocolate...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It has so many different flavors, it's 
like my whole body is rejoicing! Who knew 
chocolate could be made like this?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. The good ingredients definitely 
help, but it's even more about all the 
love Ryan-san put into it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, eat this chocolate and give it 
your all! Your feelings will definitely 
reach them!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by Mejiro Ryan's special 
chocolates, the little angels took off as 
if they had grown wings.
